title: Desktop / Discover
slide_intent: Separate platform navigation from varied content so viewers can find their way without losing the richness of the catalogue.
strategic_value: Restrained purple cues can connect Twitch’s light interface to the more expressive identity surrounding it.
demonstration: A light desktop Discover screen places navigation and followed channels around a featured game and a row of live-channel cards.
practical_value: Compare where brand color supports navigation and where content imagery leads.

content_islands.name: Navigation frame
content_islands.spec: Keep the top controls and left channel list distinct from the main content area.

content_islands.name: Discovery content
content_islands.spec: Place a featured game above recommended live-channel cards inside the light interface.

content_islands.name: Presentation ground
content_islands.spec: Set the screenshot on a pale-to-purple field that remains outside the product UI.

reference_purposes.Application: The identity is shown within a light desktop discovery interface.
